If it is not a directory or directory is not found, should we exit silently?
Addressed.
what if remove fails, does still this API should fail, or use error_code and log PEL/journal log in case remove fails ?
Added journal log incase remove fails

Should we throw and exit even for one failure? Or Log whatever failed and continue with as much as possible?
We can log a PEL with all that failed?
Added PEL to log list of paths for which restoration failed.
Do we need this?

As part of `moveFiles()`, each `chassis*` directory will be deleted from the backup path. After which `<inventory_backup_path>/system` directory still exists.
 This API clears the `/system` under `<inventory_backup_path>`
As discussed, removed unused variable. Not sure why this wasn't flagged by compiler.

Same here, in case of multiple failure we will not pollute the journal?

variable name is different

bcz container data type should implement string() api ?

so we can reduce this nested if.
